name: Milan Herring
source:
"I am a decorative blacksmith. I've always been a decorative blacksmith. I can't afford to worry about anything else."

He is the owner of the blacksmith store "Herring" in the town of Balarboa in the common district. He runs the business by himself.

He has been a blacksmith since his childhood. He is a typical craftsman.

He sometimes destroys his own work if he doesn't like it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/tsuitsui/chara/]official website[/url]]
